limitations: This is an offline identity delta against the frozen 50-item report; no terminal-owned chain or fabrication pipeline was rerun.
The newly mapped identities were promoted only after the off-chain ingest added exact manufacturer-backed rows to forge-truth and the DB-only resolver plus local KiCad parity checks passed.

The former Colorimeter regulator closure remains withdrawn because the frozen source board contains no regulator; the connector is now closed against the source-identified BOOMELE 1.0T-4P rather than the previously incorrect JST BM04.
NinjaPCR's regulator remains unresolved because a direct 12 V rail exceeds the MCP1700 absolute input range; the exact MCP1700 symbol is now closed but a compliant replacement MPN is still required.

Manufacturer pinouts close NAU7802SGI and OPA334AIDBVR symbol uncertainty, but both remain rejected for the cited Rodeostat/OpenDrop roles; 4-2489541-7 remains unsupported because no authoritative PCB package/terminal geometry was found.
No candidate without an exact manufacturer ordering code, compatible ratings, package, and symbol/pinout source was promoted.
Sixteen roles were removed only from fitted-component scope; each retains an explicit whole-system owner or board-function requirement in the architecture record.
